messages:
ravi: Starting a phased rollout for model-proxy v4.0.0. Change window is 45m. Plan: 3% -> 10% -> 30%. Requesting go/stage confirmation from infra and ops. @deploy-bot kick it off?

deploy-bot: acknowledged. job=staged-deploy model-proxy v4.0.0. phase=1 traffic=3%. monitors=[p50,p95,error-rate,connection-retries]. rollout-docs: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/deploys#phased-rollouts

tara: quick smoke looks ok locally. I'll watch metrics, will flag any drift.

kai: FYI I'm watching connection-retries from edge-pool-b. If retries spike >0.5% for 3m, call stop. Also flagging auth-layer latency on one zone (auth-proxy p95 120ms -> 260ms).

infra-bot: autoscaler note: node warmers running on 70% of nodes. warmup_state=partial. Recommend waiting for warmup finish before next step.

ravi: good catch. hold on progression until warmup completes or we confirm it's not related. setting manual hold.

deploy-bot: progression paused. current_traffic=3.1% next_target=10% blocked_by=manual-hold. pinned_version=model-proxy@v4.0.0-canary.

kai: digging traces, seeing connect retry pattern: ```
[2026-05-11T09:14:01Z] connect: dial -> ECONNRESET -> retry
[2026-05-11T09:14:02Z] auth-proxy: token refresh triggered, 120ms
```

ops-lead: proposal: continue only if retries drop under 0.2% for 10m and p95 auth <200ms. Otherwise rollback to v3.9.7. Also add temporary traffic cap at 12% for next phase.

tara: I can trigger a forced warmup on the remaining nodes now (quick script). If infra-bot confirms completion, we can re-evaluate in 12m.

infra-bot: warmup_job started by tara on pool=edge-pool-b. expected_finish ~10m. progress=20%

ravi: OK. hold remains. creating ticket RD-2274 to track warmup & tracing.

kai: after initial warmup run p95 auth back down to ~140ms in that zone. connect retries 0.18% over last 5m. looks stable so far.

ops-lead: thumbs up for re-eval at +12m. keep auto-rollback thresholds: error-rate>=1% for 90s OR connection-retries>=0.5% for 3m OR p95>=500ms.

deploy-bot: notes: auto-rollback thresholds set. manual pin active. to continue, someone needs to issue `deploy-bot continue` or remove the manual-hold in console.

tara: warmup job finished, infra-bot reports all nodes warmed. warmup_state=complete. posting small metric snapshot below.

tara: metrics snapshot: p50 80ms, p95 180ms, error-rate 0.02%, connection-retries 0.15% (5m window).

ravi: based on snapshot and ops thresholds I'm comfortable moving to 10% now. any objections? :eyes:

kai: no objections. will keep an eye on auth latency.

ops-lead: go from me. remember to cap next phase at 12% (ops precaution).

deploy-bot: command received: continue. scaling to 10% (cap=12%). phase=2 started. monitors engaged.

ravi: thanks. I'll update release notes and post-merge changelog: include kv warmup fixes and auth backoff change.

infra-bot: alert: small autoscaler jitter on pool C during phase increment; 2 nodes briefly cycled, no errors observed.

kai: small blip noted on one shard (p95 220ms) immediately after phase bump, settled within 90s. no sustained alarms.

ops-lead: keep monitoring for full 15m before we move to 30%. if anything above thresholds, we abort and rollback.

ravi: tracking ENG-2274 and will push a short status update to #release-notes after 30m. thanks all.
